title: Conditional Supervised Contrastive Learning for Fair Text Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Equalized Odds gap (the sum of True Positive Rate and False Positive Rate equality differences) across racial/ethnic identity groups, specifically comparing 'black' and 'non-black' identities in the Jigsaw-toxicity online comment classification dataset.

Measuring the Equalized Odds gap (the sum of True Positive Rate and False Positive Rate equality differences) across binary genders (male and female) using the Biasbios dataset for multi-class occupation classification.
